_about: Machine-readable index of the 70 Viewsari competency questions used by run_cq_evaluation.py. Mirrors data/ontology/CQ_CATALOG.md and dissertation Appendix B. SPARQL-answerable CQs reference a query under queries/; descriptive CQs (FAIR/teaching/UX) carry a rationale field instead.

questions.question: Who co-occurred with whom in The Lives?
Did artist X co-occur with artist Y?
Which artists are mentioned together in the same passage?
Where in the text did artists X and Y co-occur (paragraph, biography, volume)?
How frequently do two given artists co-occur across the entire corpus?
Which artists have the highest co-occurrence frequency with artist X?
What is the PMI score for the co-occurrence of artists X and Y?
questions.expected_gap: PMI scores are not yet materialised on viewsari:cooccurrence instances; query probes for hasPMI / hasPMIScore.

questions.question: What is the network centrality of artist X in the co-occurrence network?
questions.expected_gap: Centrality is computed externally; SPARQL surfaces the degree (count of distinct co-occurring partners) as a proxy.

questions.question: What are the birth and death dates of person X?
questions.expected_gap: Dates are reachable via federated Wikidata lookup; locally, the query returns owl:sameAs targets used for that lookup.

questions.question: Which persons mentioned in The Lives are identified as artists?
questions.expected_gap: viewsari:Artist subclass (RQII.4) is not yet asserted; query approximates by selecting persons that participate in at least one co-occurrence.

questions.question: Which persons mentioned in The Lives are not artists (e.g., patrons, clergy, scholars)?
questions.expected_gap: Same as CQI.10; complement set computed by NOT EXISTS against participation in co-occurrences.

questions.question: In which biography (biographies) does person X appear?
Is person X linked to an external authority record (e.g., Wikidata)?
Which artworks are mentioned in the biography of artist X?
Which locations are associated with artist X?
questions.expected_gap: Location entities are sparsely populated in the current KG iteration.

questions.question: Which artworks were created in location L?
questions.expected_gap: Creation-place edges between artworks and locations are not yet materialised; query requires future enrichment.

questions.question: Can students explore artist collaborations on a geographical map?
questions.expected_gap: UX concern; SPARQL surfaces the artist-location join that a map view would consume.

questions.question: Where is location X located on a map?
questions.expected_gap: Geographic coordinates are reachable only through federated Wikidata lookup; query returns the owl:sameAs anchor.

questions.question: Which paragraph and page in The Lives is the source of co-occurrence C?
Which volume of The Lives contains the biography of artist X?
What edition or translation of The Lives was used for extracting a given co-occurrence?
What is the original text snippet associated with co-occurrence C?
What licence is provided by the Viewsari dataset and where can the original source text be found?
How can I execute semantic searches over the knowledge graph?
questions.rationale: Process question — answered by tooling/documentation (SPARQL endpoint at GraphDB, examples in docs/sparql_examples). Not a graph-pattern query.

questions.question: How can I reuse the Viewsari data in my own project, and in what form can it be shared?
questions.rationale: FAIR/reuse policy question — answered by README, license metadata, and dataset distribution formats (TTL, JSON-LD, OWL).

questions.question: Is there a SPARQL endpoint or an RDF dump available?
questions.rationale: Infrastructure availability — answered by deployment docs (GraphDB endpoint at /repositories/viewsari, RDF dump at data/kg/viewsari_kg.ttl).

questions.question: Which external resources (ontologies, authority data) were used in constructing the knowledge graph?
Which authority data (e.g., Wikidata, Iconclass) is connected to the resources?
How can my students reuse data in the project course, and can the visualizations be modified and customized?
questions.rationale: Pedagogical/UX question — answered by the open-source repository (CC BY 4.0) and documentation, not by graph patterns.

questions.question: What is the difference between a statistical co-occurrence and an explicitly typed relationship between two artists in the knowledge graph?
questions.expected_gap: Probes for both viewsari:0001025 (cooccurrence) and any typed relationship class such as viewsari:Collaboration/viewsari:hasPupil — the latter is not yet modelled.

questions.question: How can I distinguish statistical co-occurrences from explicit relationships in computational models?
questions.expected_gap: Returns counts per association type; the typed-relationship branch returns 0 until typed relationships are extracted.

questions.question: Which artists have both a statistical co-occurrence and an explicit typed relationship with artist X?
questions.expected_gap: Empty until typed relationships are populated.

questions.question: What is the Dice coefficient for the co-occurrence of artists X and Y, and how does it compare to the PMI score?
questions.expected_gap: Statistical scores not yet materialised on cooccurrence nodes.

questions.question: How do I explore relationships between Renaissance artists, artworks, historical events, or locations to identify patterns and trends?
questions.rationale: UX/exploration question — answered by visual frontends and SPARQL examples; not a single graph pattern.

questions.question: Which artworks are explicitly named in the biography of artist X, and which are described only implicitly?
What is the surface form by which artwork A is referred to in paragraph P, and is it explicit, implicit, or coreferential?
Which artworks are classified as out-of-knowledge-base (OOKB) — no match in Wikidata?
Which artworks co-occur with a specific artist in a particular volume, and what are the source paragraphs?
questions.expected_gap: Cooccurrences in the current KG are person↔person; artwork participation requires future extension of the cooccurrence_analysis activity.

questions.question: Can I explore how artworks reflect collaborative effects, such as shared locations or artistic styles?
Which locations are mentioned in co-occurrences involving artist X?
questions.expected_gap: Same as CQII.9 — cooccurrences are not yet location-typed.

questions.question: Which artists were active in location L according to The Lives?
questions.expected_gap: Requires artist↔location edges that are not yet extracted.

questions.question: Is location L linked to an external authority record (e.g., Wikidata, GeoNames)?
questions.expected_gap: No location instances are populated in this KG iteration; the ASK necessarily returns false.

questions.question: Can students explore artist collaborations on a geographical map, filtered by location?
questions.rationale: UX / map view, depends on CQI.17 substrate.

questions.question: Which historical events are associated with artist X in the knowledge graph?
questions.expected_gap: viewsari:HistoricalEvent class is declared (RQII.12) but no instances are populated in this KG iteration.

questions.question: Which artworks were commissioned or destroyed as part of a specific historical event E?
questions.expected_gap: Same as CQII.15.

questions.question: How can I identify cross-disciplinary connections between Renaissance art and other historical or cultural phenomena?
Can information about historical events be enriched from external sources (Wikidata)?
questions.rationale: Enrichment process question — to be answered by federated query design once events are populated.

questions.question: How can I distinguish work-, expression-, and manifestation-level bibliographic metadata?
Which edition and translation of The Lives is the source of a given extracted entity or co-occurrence?
What is the direct web URL to the paragraph in the Project Gutenberg edition?
Is the extracted information derived from Du Vere's 1912 English translation, the 1568 Italian edition, or another version?
How does the choice of translation affect the entities and co-occurrences in the KG?
questions.rationale: Comparative analysis question — requires parallel KGs from each translation, which is outside the current data.

questions.question: For co-occurrences involving artist X, can I compare the English and Italian web manifestations?
questions.expected_gap: The Italian edition has no manifestation in the current KG; query returns the English manifestation only.

questions.question: Which entities in the KG are linked to Wikidata, and what properties are mapped?
Which entities are classified as OOKB (no matching Wikidata entry)?
Can I perform a federated SPARQL query combining Viewsari data with an external endpoint (e.g., Wikidata)?
questions.rationale: Capability question — demonstrated by the federated query template at scripts/evaluation/queries/federated_example.rq (illustrative only, requires SERVICE).

questions.question: How can I use Viewsari as a research tool for cross-disciplinary research?
How can I apply FAIR principles to bring Viewsari into my project and share with students?
questions.rationale: FAIR / data-management question; documented in README + license metadata.

questions.question: How can I use Viewsari as an interactive visualization platform in lectures?
Can I conduct a proof-of-concept project reusing Viewsari?
How can I integrate Viewsari into my teaching curriculum?
How can I explore relationships between artists, artworks, or locations to identify trends and accumulations of collaborations in a city?
questions.rationale: Exploration question; underlying substrate is CQI.4 + CQI.15.

questions.question: Which extraction activity (NER run, LLM prompt run) generated entity E, and what software agent was used?
What was the prompt template used in the extraction run that produced entity E?
Which entities were extracted by a statistical method (co-occurrence/NER) versus a generative LLM method?
What model version and timestamp are associated with extraction run R?
How are implicit entity mentions distinguished from explicit ones, and can I query them separately?
For a given extraction result, can I trace the provenance chain entity → annotation → paragraph → page → volume → translation → original work?
Does the KG allow me to assess whether a claimed relationship between two artists is supported by explicit textual evidence, an implicit inference, or purely statistical co-occurrence?
How does the ontology represent the epistemic weight of a co-occurrence (PMI) compared to an implicit mention (LLM)?
questions.rationale: Modelling-philosophy question — answered by the ontology's class hierarchy and provenance pattern (cooccurrence vs implicit_mention each carry distinct prov:Activity types), surfaced by CQII.36 and CQII.38 result counts.
